meta.title: x/tools/gopls/internal/analysis/modernize: the conversion of variadic functions to `slices.ContainsFunc` causes type errors
meta.fix_ref: golang/tools@a99a1c3c8372 (gopls/internal/analysis/modernize: prevent conversion of variadic functions to slices.ContainsFunc; CL 663436)
meta.build_notes: Both built and run with go1.24.4 (golang.org/dl, under temp/lsp_servers/go-sdks; toolchain.json), as for the other v0.18.1/v0.19.0 cases. The reporter ran the modernize command of gopls v0.18.1; the fix merged 2025-04, v0.19.0 was tagged 2025-06-10.
meta.notes: The slicescontains pass accepted a predicate call isEven(num) whose callee is variadic (func(int, ...any) bool) and passed it to slices.ContainsFunc, which needs func(E) bool. The fix skips variadic callees, so the post-fix build reports no diagnostic for this loop.

settings_note: The modernize analyzer is on by default in both builds; the reporter ran the modernize command, which runs the same analyzer.

files.source: issue body, 'What did you see happen?' diff (the removed '-' lines and the unchanged lines)
files.note: the code before the fix, reassembled from the diff (the '-' lines and the context lines, diff markers removed), with a package clause 'package main' added
a module around the file; go 1.24 (the slices modernizers need go1.21)

repro.steps: Open main.go. The slicescontains pass reports the loop in check ('Loop can be simplified using slices.ContainsFunc'). Apply its fix. Reported: 'return slices.ContainsFunc(nums, isEven)' fails with 'in call to slices.ContainsFunc, type func(num int, opt ...any) bool of isEven does not match func(E) bool'. Probe: a fresh session on the edited text must report no error the original did not have; no fix offered means absent.

target.message_re: Loop can be simplified using slices\.ContainsFunc
